MORE:
We herewith enclose the unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the First Quarter ended on 30th June 2026 as approved by the Board of Directors together with the Limited Review Report as submitted by the Statutory Auditors.

The meeting commenced at 15:00 Hrs on Friday, 24th July, 2026 and concluded at 17:45 Hrs on Friday, 24th July, 2026
